name: workstation
description: Personal workstation plugins, tracked in yadm (~/.config/ai/claude-plugins)

plugins.name: workstation-mcp
plugins.description: Core MCP servers shared with Antigravity and OpenCode (GitHub, memory, fetch, MarkItDown, Nextcloud, package versions, DuckDuckGo, Thunderbird, Grounded Docs)

plugins.name: workstation-dev
plugins.description: Development MCP servers; switched off per directory in .claude/settings.json where no code is written

plugins.name: workstation-research
plugins.description: Research and law MCP servers (arXiv, Zotero, OpenAlex, Phở, Obsidian search, Wikipedia, YouTube, RIS, EUR-Lex, NASA)

plugins.name: workstation-travel
plugins.description: Travel MCP servers (Open-Meteo, OpenRouteService, ÖBB, trip-scout, trip-planner)
